source_type_legend.official_public: Publicly published official document or webpage.
source_type_legend.repository_processed_reference: Repository processed navigation layer (not a new authority source).
source_type_legend.repository_maintainer_provisional: Provisional data provided by repository maintainers; usable for proposal generation and self-check, but NOT for official redline, approval basis, or precise area basis (see data/source_registry.json).
source_type_legend.user_provided_cleared: User-provided and rights-cleared material (e.g., agent taskbook).
source_type_legend.agent_inferred_from_public_data: Agent-derived inference from public data (not used in this submission; all boundary/key-area sources are repository_maintainer_provisional).

clearance_status_legend.approved_formal: Source cleared for use as a formal reference in this submission: officially published, publicly accessible, and no third-party brand/portrait/image asset is embedded without rights. International city references are cleared for conceptual reference only and carry no government commitment or implementation arrangement.
